rules.sentence: The overall incidence of CTEPH after acute pulmonary embolism is 2.82%.
Both the European Society of Cardiology (ESC)/European Respiratory Society (ERS) and American guidelines recommend pulmonary endarterectomy (PEA) as the gold standard treatment for CTEPH.
However, it is estimated that up to 50% of patients are considered inoperable.
Balloon pulmonary angioplasty (BPA) is one of the proposed techniques, as reported by Zhang et al., to have a higher survival rate, improved exercise capacity, and fewer complications than PEA.
